scientific_integrity: Generalized Cesàro compactness, fixed ordinary eigenvalues and Hilbert–Schmidt membership are prior results. Finite computational diagnostics supplement but never establish the infinite-dimensional statements.
scientific_limitations: The Weyl coefficient is a specialization of known general spectral-distribution principles. Exterior-product order is proved non-strictly at ranks beyond one; no individual-rank monotonicity or uniform near-noncompact endpoint asymptotic is asserted. A broader unindexed total-positivity theorem might imply the order. Independent mathematical review remains outstanding.
title: Exterior-power ordering and an elliptic singular-value law for compact generalized Cesàro operators
